Editing Details:

Over the few weeks of working with Jason Bourne dream trailers I've slow grown into a fan. Which you may guess the inspiration to make a better plot. Upon researching I learned that Jason Bourne and James Bond is the big dream of everyone so I figured why not make the "asset" played by Daniel Craig. I was gonna make it actual 007 vs Bourne, but that seem unrealistic, so I simply made it "asset" that has a personal issue with our hero. WANDER helped bring the plot of Bond's issue with Bourne is losing his family. 

Ofcourse Aaron Cross will be helping to continue the awesome crossover. I even made them have an actual introduction using clip of Damon from Jimmy Kimmel saying "great to meet you man" and clip of Renner from MAYOR OF KINGSTOWN, "Good to see you" line from TAG. I made Bond's introduction to be epic by showing drawing of Daniel Craig after the line "It's coming" from MAYOR OF KINGSTOWN referring to 007 being their biggest challenge. 

Just like the previews version I made Bourne visit Philippines by showing clips of the country with Renner seeing him for the first time. I even hired someone to do breaking news to show that Bourne and Cross are wanted. Last version Gerald Butler showed up so I made him cameo in this one too. "He found me...the asset" perfect line from K1LL THE MESSENGER to mention Bond. I had to make wording sequence fresh with "No more secrets" since this is what the franchise is all about. "He might know something" from STILLWATER I added to make Bourne wanting to talk to Bond to know about his past.
